questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: For v(t)=t²−4t+3 (m/s), find total distance between t=0 and t=4 s.
questions.explanation: v=(t−1)(t−3). Antiderivative F=t³/3−2t²+3t. F(0)=0,F(1)=4/3,F(3)=0,F(4)=4/3. Total distance=4/3+4/3+4/3=4 m.

questions.prompt: From a platform 45 m high, a stone is dropped. At the same instant, a second stone is projected vertically upward from ground at 20 m/s. With g=10 m/s², when are they at the same height?
questions.explanation: Heights: upper stone y₁=45−5t²; lower stone y₂=20t−5t². Equate:45=20t ⇒ t=2.25 s (both still above ground at that instant).

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: Car A moves at constant 20 m/s. Car B is 60 m ahead, moving at 10 m/s and accelerates forward at 2 m/s². Can A catch B?
questions.explanation: Relative gap g(t)=60−(20−10)t+½(2)t² =60−10t+t². Its minimum occurs at t=5 s and is 35 m>0, so there is no meeting.

questions.prompt: An elevator starts from rest, accelerates upward at 2 m/s² for 3 s, then accelerates downward at 1 m/s² for 6 s, and finally downward at 3 m/s² for 2 s. Find total distance and final velocity (upward positive).
questions.explanation: First phase: v=6 m/s, displacement +9 m. Second: v falls from +6 to 0, displacement +18 m. Third: it starts from rest, moves downward 6 m and ends at −6 m/s. Total distance=9+18+6=33 m.
